Luxury hair brand, TOL Luxe Hairs, has signed reality television star and entrepreneur, Mercy Eke, as its brand ambassador.
A statement made available to Saturday Beats said the partnership was part of the company’s efforts to strengthen its presence in Nigeria’s beauty market and reach a wider audience.
Eke rose to prominence after winning the fourth season of Big Brother Naija and has since built a public profile across entertainment, fashion and lifestyle.
The company expressed optimism that her appointment would boost brand awareness and support its efforts to expand its reach in Nigeria’s competitive hair industry.
TOL Luxe Hairs operates under TOL Group of Companies, founded by entrepreneur, Eyitayo Francis, in 2015. The group has interests in beauty, hair extensions, fragrances and automobiles.
The group said its business philosophy centres on quality, innovation, customer satisfaction and the development of trusted Nigerian brands.
It added that the partnership with Eke reflects its commitment to strategic collaborations and sustained brand visibility as it seeks to expand its footprint in the country’s luxury hair segment.
